goal.text: Retrace the dessert prep without skipping a step - get the cream spread, the utensils rinsed and the fruit sliced and plated - and confirm when there is nothing left to do.

turns.text: What did I pick up with my left hand?

trigger.detail: she finished mixing and reached for something on the worktop

expected_answer.text: You grabbed a tissue and used it to lift the crumbles that had dropped onto the worktop.

turns.text: — I showed her. What was on it?

trigger.detail: the tissue was held up toward the peer

expected_answer.text: A fly. You held the paper up for her to see, then pressed it flat on the surface.

turns.text: hold on — where did it end up? Did you see me bin it?

trigger.detail: she worries the insect is still loose near the food

expected_answer.text: Not binned. You pressed down once, then handed the whole thing to your peer around forty-two seconds.

turns.text: Right. And straight after that?

trigger.detail: gaze left the greenery and settled on the doorway

expected_answer.text: You took hold of the pan and started stirring the chocolate inside it with your right hand.

turns.text: — which I then did what with? I remember walking somewhere.

trigger.detail: the stirring stopped and she stepped back from the counter

expected_answer.text: You wiped it on the rim, carried it over, moved it into your other hand and rinsed it under running water.

turns.text: Ugh, okay. Remind me not to leave stuff lying around like that.

trigger.detail: a lull while she shakes the water off

expected_answer.text: I will say something if anything gets left out on the worktop again.

turns.text: Back to the pan. What's my left hand doing?

trigger.detail: a scoop of cream came out of the cup

expected_answer.text: It swaps roles. It cradles the cup while you dig in, then steadies the dish while you spread.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm— sorry, I never put that cup down?

trigger.detail: the same scoop-and-spread cycle has repeated several times

expected_answer.text: Not yet. You keep lifting it again between spreads; it only goes back on the worktop much later.

turns.text: oh — by the way, is anything still sitting over by the taps from earlier?

trigger.detail: she asks about a part of the room she is not looking at

expected_answer.text: Nothing. The only thing you carried across was the spatula, and that came straight back with you.

turns.text: What was I fiddling with on my wrist?

trigger.detail: the bowl was set down in the basin and the tap opened

expected_answer.text: The recording unit strapped to your left hand. You tapped at it with your right, spatula still held.

turns.text: — still running. Where did the cup go?

trigger.detail: she finished checking the wrist-worn device

expected_answer.text: Down on the side, left-handed, and then you laid the spatula across the top of it.

turns.text: sorry, quick one — I mean the bowl. Where did that go?

trigger.detail: she repairs her own previous question

expected_answer.text: You walked it across in your left hand, opened the tap, and set it down in the basin.

turns.text: What came out of there before I filled it?

trigger.detail: the water was shut off and she turned away

expected_answer.text: A container that had been sitting in there. You lifted it out and parked it on the side.

turns.text: — and just before I went back for that?

trigger.detail: a drawer was pushed shut

expected_answer.text: You backed up, opened a cupboard and shut it again right-handed, then came forward to the basin.

turns.text: um, hang on — am I still hunting for something? That's three drawers now.

trigger.detail: repeated drawer openings with nothing taken out

expected_answer.text: Two, and you are shutting the second one now. Nothing has come out of either of them.

turns.text: Fine, forget those. I'll take whatever's hanging up instead.

trigger.detail: she gives up on the drawers and turns around

expected_answer.text: Fair enough. It is on the run you just walked away from, behind your right shoulder.

turns.text: Found it. Where was this thing hanging?

trigger.detail: the knife came off its holder and she turned to walk

expected_answer.text: On the rack at the far end, right-hand side. You leaned in and took it as you passed.

turns.text: — right, and the fruit was already out?

trigger.detail: the first cut was made

expected_answer.text: No, that came after. You dragged an apple over left-handed and went into it straight away.

turns.text: So how long have I been working on this one?

trigger.detail: the same cutting motion has run uninterrupted

expected_answer.text: Roughly fourteen seconds of cutting, all right-handed, with your other hand pinning it to the board.

turns.text: That's one done. What about the middle bit?

trigger.detail: the core was set aside and the slices were lined up

expected_answer.text: Set it aside on the board with your free hand, then nudged the slices into a row.

turns.text: — and the other half? Still whole?

trigger.detail: the second half was picked up

expected_answer.text: Only just started. It sat untouched until a few seconds ago, when you began working through it.

turns.text: Why am I going back over pieces I cut?

trigger.detail: a trimmed-off core was set aside

expected_answer.text: Some of them still carry core. You are picking those out one by one and trimming it off.

turns.text: no, I mean — how many have needed that so far? Two?

trigger.detail: she narrows her own question to a count

expected_answer.text: Three. One on the first pass, a second after it, and you have just lifted a third.

turns.text: Right. I'll clear these and get them onto a plate. Keep count for me.

trigger.detail: the trimming settles into a steady rhythm

expected_answer.text: Will do. I will tell you once every piece is clear and ready to go out.

turns.text: They're all plated. Did I look away just then?

trigger.detail: gaze came off the doorway and landed on the wall behind the counter

expected_answer.text: Yes, briefly. Your eyes came off the doorway and went to the wall behind you, hands still arranging.

turns.text: — was it still in view, though? The green one in the corner.

trigger.detail: the potted greenery left frame and did not return

expected_answer.text: No. It dropped out of shot about six seconds before that and has not come back since.

turns.text: So is there anything left for me to do here, or am I finished?

trigger.detail: gaze crossed from one stretch of wall to another as she turned

expected_answer.text: You are finished. Put the spatula down and follow your peer out of the kitchen.
